items.period: Received Shuowen small-seal form; the vector file was revised in 2017–2018
items.tradition: Shuowen seal script; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw of 是 in the received Shuowen seal-script style. Shuowen analyzes this form as 日 plus 正; the graph’s earlier bronze form should not be assumed to have the same analysis.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of the character 是 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The file description identifies the character and script style, cites its Sinica source record, and provides explicit CC0/public-domain reuse terms. It illustrates the received seal-form account while making no claim to be an ancient artifact image.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: The selected image is a modern vector redraw of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact photograph; the exact Commons bronze-file page returned 429 and no bronze image was selected.
The accessible Sinica page indexes bronze item 集成02724 but does not explain its graphic components; the selected seal redraw cannot resolve that earlier formation question.
